question: Can the existing eight-neuron controller acquire useful joint locomotion through bounded genotype optimization or existing lifetime plasticity?
search_intent: Source-derived implementation audit and authored simulation experiments. No external scientific publications were searched or consulted in M6.
CONSULTED: existing Rust controller, sensing, body, world/accounting and viewer
local Bevy0.20 screenshot API source for technical integration
IMPLEMENTED: examples/support/m6.rs: food-free provisioned nursery, full neural/motor trace, matched coast
m6_assess.rs: held-out, lifetime, directional and mechanistic controls
examples/m6_mechanism.rs: no-world-edit post-hoc integer lunge/shape decomposition of recorded native states

VALIDATED.mechanism: Native recurrent joint locomotion under existing authored law2; held-out selected improvement, no jets, zero vacuum travel, controlled fees/accounting and replay. See docs/m6/ANALYSIS.json and VALIDATION.json.
VALIDATED.nulls: No useful lifetime motor acquisition; 0/8 corrected-cue directional successes. First steering campaign invalid because all scent channels saturated; preserved and rerun after sensor regression.
VALIDATED.not_validated: Biological learning, continuum hydrodynamics, soft-body physics, ecological survival/transfer, autonomous food search, active braking or exploration intelligence.

knowledge_transfer: No published claims transferred. Fitness/gates, high-energy nursery, environmental direction cue and genotype search are explicit authored experimental choices. Existing body lunge and resistive coupling remain simulation assumptions.
chronology: Protocol preceded movement search; held-out opened after locked selection. Direction v1 ran before sensor validation, error disclosed and retained. V2 reduced cue concentration only and passed local sensor/material/no-impulse test before rerun. Post-selection falsification was registered after primary results and never used for retuning. Final audit caught lowercase bend versus serialized Bend filter, invalidating the initial shape-only attribution. Corrected schema check and compiled Rust component audit confirm both shape and authored lunge; superseded analysis/report/source preserved in v2 addenda. No native motion/fitness/replay results changed.
